key_findings: Puerarin reduced pain hypersensitivity in oxaliplatin-treated mice, decreased spinal NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-1beta and raised Nrf2 and GPX4.
Puerarin increased Nrf2-GPX4 association, suggesting Nrf2/GPX4-mediated antioxidant action.
